targets.authors: Altmann, S., Falk, A., & Wibral, M.
targets.title: Promotions and incentives: The case of multistage elimination tournaments.
targets.evidence_quote: In the interest of comparing the two sets of results, and for the sake of clarity, I replicate the relevant section of Table 2 in Altmann, Falk and Wibral (2012), and I add alongside the new set of results.
targets.outcome_quote: Result: The mean effort in the TS treatment is lower than in the OS treatment, but the p-value from from the Mann-Whitney test of their difference is larger than 0.05 (p=0.150)
targets.outcome_reasoning: The report specifies that replication requires greater two-stage effort and p<.05; it reports reversed ordering and p=.150. No author verdict of an uninformative test is given.
